# AI-034: Auto-generated model cards

## Behaviour

- Cards are built from the registry record, not from claims: intended use, training data pointer, eval scores sorted by suite, safety pass rate, limitations and caveats. A safety pass rate under 0.95 adds a caveat automatically.
- Empty limitations get an honest default line instead of silence. The card is fingerprinted (cardfp_ prefix) and stored once per model and version; a second card is a 409 conflict (model-card-duplicate).
- Cards for versions that do not exist are refused (model-version-not-found).

## Where it lives

src/modules/ai-training/engine/model-registry-engine.ts (pure), reached through POST /v1/ai-training/models/cards.

## Limits, stated plainly

- Eval scores are declared by the caller, not measured here. The card is only as honest as the eval suite behind it.
